content.text:
Shipyard, Tavern and Market
arrive in Phase 5

events.comment: PORT (Phase 1 stub). Full harbor with Shipyard/Tavern/Market is Phase 5.

SAILING SCENE -- logic lives in external events, one per manager.
VoyageManager: voyage state machine + distance + ocean scroll.
UIManager: responsive layout, HUD refresh, HUD buttons.
Order matters: state logic runs before UI so the HUD shows this frame's values.

VOYAGE STATE MACHINE. Voyage.State holds exactly one of:
PORT, SAILING, ENCOUNTER_APPROACH, ENCOUNTER_DECISION, COMBAT, BOARDING,
PARLEY, TRADE, EVENT, REWARDS, RETURNING, SUNK.
Change state ONLY by setting Voyage.State and resetting Voyage.StateTime to 0.
Phase 1 implements SAILING and RETURNING; other states are reserved.

events.name: Voyage start (new voyage every time this scene opens)
State timer (seconds spent in current state, frame-rate independent)
STATE: RETURNING (ship slows, then the Port scene opens)

events.comment: Phase 5 will bank Voyage.Gold / cargo into Player here before leaving.

events.name: Ocean scroll (eases toward ScrollTarget; offsets wrap to stay small)

events.comment:
RESPONSIVE LAYOUT. Game uses 'scaleOuter': the 720x1280 reference is always
fully visible, taller phones get extra height, tablets get extra width.
Everything is positioned from SceneWindowWidth/Height, and recomputed only
when the window size changes (not every frame).
Settings.SafeTop/SafeBottom reserve space for notches / home indicators.

events.name: HUD refresh (5x per second, not every frame, to avoid re-rendering text)
